title: Correlation — written update
situation: In a technical discussion, a request crosses HTTP and a database dependency. You must write the decision accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Write four sentences on how the correlation identifier travels, where it is created, and what breaks the chain.

vocabulary.meaning: following one request across every component it touches, using an identifier that survives each hop
the point where a correlation identifier stops being propagated, after which two related events can no longer be linked

expectedElements: The origin of the identifier is stated
Its propagation across at least two components is described
One realistic way the chain breaks is named
modelAnswer: The correlation identifier is created at the edge if the caller did not supply one, then carried in the request context through the handler and tagged onto the database command. One identifier therefore ties the evidence from the incoming request, the work performed, and the query issued. The chain breaks wherever background work is started without propagating the context, because the new task begins with a fresh one. That is the first place to check when two related events cannot be correlated.
commonMistakes: Describing tracing without saying where the identifier originates
Omitting the propagation boundary where the chain actually breaks
variants: Rewrite the update after correlation was lost in a background job.
